title: Understanding Variance
text: Variance in a model refers to how much the model's predictions change when using different training data. Adding random features can increase the complexity of the model, which might lead to higher variance.

title: Impact of Random Features
text: Consider how adding a feature that doesn't have a clear relationship with the target variable might affect the model's ability to generalize to new data.

title: Evaluating the Statement
